content.title: COLM Q2 Deep Dive: International Demand Grows as U.S. Headwinds and Tariffs Weigh on Guidance
content.summary: Outerwear manufacturer Columbia Sportswear (NASDAQ:COLM) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales up 6.1% year on year to $605.2 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $913 million was less impressive, coming in 2.2% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP loss of $0.19 per share was 20% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
